title: SDW100 2024 Infopack — official archive
claims: The 2024 edition started at 0600 on Saturday 8 June 2024, with a 30 hour limit and cut-offs at every aid station.
The 2024 infopack lists course records of Mark Perkins (M) 14:03:54 in 2014 and Bethan Male (F) 16:49:57 in 2022.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接抓取并读取 2024 届 infopack。2024 为单一起跑 0600，与 2025–2027 的两波起跑不同。
